title: ImageRSI: Verification-Driven Recursive Self-Improvement for Agentic Image Generation
abstract: arXiv:2610.32120v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Complex text-to-image requests remain difficult to satisfy reliably. Verifying and repairing an image can fix an individual output, but a successful repair does not necessarily carry over to other requests. We present ImageRSI, a framework that keeps the image generator frozen and combines three components: five-dimensional verification and repair within each task, an experience library shared across tasks, and offline updating of the judge. Candidate experiences enter the library only after paired A/B validation, and the judge is updated with supervised fine-tuning and GRPO on accumulated image-judgment records and evaluated before reuse. We also introduce ImageReq-Bench, a benchmark of 961 requests built around hard cases in real-world image-generation requests, each paired with an evaluation checklist. ImageRSI achieves a Checklist Strict Accuracy (CSA) of 52.6% on MindBench (with Nano Banana Pro as the generator) and 65.66% on Imag

translated_title: ImageRSI：面向智能体图像生成的验证驱动递归自我改进
translated_abstract: 复杂的文本到图像请求仍然难以被可靠地满足。对图像进行验证和修复可以修正单个输出，但一次成功的修复并不一定能迁移到其他请求上。我们提出了 ImageRSI，一个保持图像生成器冻结不变的框架，它结合了三个组件：任务内部的五维验证与修复、跨任务共享的经验库，以及评判器的离线更新。候选经验只有在通过成对 A/B 验证后才会进入经验库，而评判器则基于积累的图像评判记录，通过监督微调和 GRPO 进行更新，并在复用前经过评估。我们还引入了 ImageReq-Bench，这是一个包含 961 条请求的基准测试，围绕真实世界图像生成请求中的困难案例构建，每条请求都配有评估清单。ImageRSI 在 MindBench 上（以 Nano Banana Pro 作为生成器）取得了 52.6% 的清单严格准确率（CSA），在 Imag（原文在此处截断）……
tldr: ImageRSI 提出了一个保持图像生成器冻结的验证驱动递归自我改进框架，通过任务内五维验证修复、经 A/B 验证的跨任务经验库以及离线更新的评判器，并发布包含 961 条困难请求的 ImageReq-Bench 基准，显著提升了复杂文生图请求的可靠满足率。
en_tdlr: ImageRSI is a verification-driven recursive self-improvement framework for agentic image generation that keeps the generator frozen while combining five-dimensional verification-repair, an A/B-validated cross-task experience library, and an offline-updated judge, achieving state-of-the-art performance and introducing the 961-request ImageReq-Bench benchmark.
